name: Ninh Binh to Pu Luong
summary: Go by road. No train reaches the reserve. Ninh Binh is a natural break on the way from Hanoi, so continue west from there by car or motorbike.

modes.note: Continue west from Ninh Binh into Thanh Hóa by car or motorbike.

seoTitle: Ninh Binh to Pu Luong — by road
seoDescription: Ninh Binh to Pu Luong Nature Reserve is a road trip west into Thanh Hoa, with no train into the reserve.

faqs.a: Ga Ninh Bình is on the North–South line, but no station serves the reserve. Go by road.

faqs.q: What if I come straight from Hanoi instead?
faqs.a: A limousine from Giáp Bát or Mỹ Đình takes about 4.5 hours.
